row: Jack Chapman - Advanced Clinical Massage Therapist

Jack Chapman, is a skilled Advanced Clinical Massage Therapist based in Welling Kent, he uses cutting edge advanced massage techniques to reduce your pain and gain back movement quickly and effectively.
As well as being a Stroke Rehabilitation Instructor and Reiki Healer, Jack is a man of many talents.

For more info, please visit:

Website - http://www.jackchapman.info/index.htm
E- mail - therapy.heaven@yahoo.co.uk
Call - 07860 227774

facebook - Jack Chapman ACMT AAI Pain & Injury Clinic
Twitter - @jackchapman1000
